what is nlp

NLP is a field of computer science and artificial intelligence that focuses on the interaction between computers and humans through natural language. It involves developing algorithms and models that enable computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language in a valuable way. NLP combines computational linguistics, machine learning, and deep learning to process and analyze large amounts of natural language data.
what is ambiguity, explain one type with example

Lexical ambiguity is when a single word has multiple meanings (e.g., 'bank' can be a financial institution or the side of a river). Syntactic ambiguy is when the sentence structure allows multiple interpretations (i.e., I saw the man with the telescope' - who had the telescope?).
